style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE mara, patagonian cavy, long legged rodent, grey brown, white rump, same animal
second_characters: owl realtors in neckties, crossing the lens

props.blocks: two concrete blocks, thrown and kicked

environment: midday steppe, dry grass packed with bushes and stones, his burrow mouth, dust
lighting: white daylight from above, hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right
motion_rule: world flies at the hero: steppe, dust and owls rush into the lens, the mara drives across frame and never stops, to the last frame. new shot size every beat, medium to close. one hero action per beat: he throws his body the full width, fills half the frame height, muzzle to the lens. an owl crosses the lens in every beat.

audio.rate: 3.9 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 6.95, then only wind
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking
audio.pronunciation: MA-ry, RO-yem, vle-ZA-yem, dol-go-VO-ye, be-TON, za-BUD-te

timeline.a: ploughs the soil at a run across the full width, clods flying back; an owl at the lens takes a clod and squats
digs on the run, earth sprays over the lens; the owl sinks into the soil up to its tie
wheels and ploughs back across the full width; an owl skids after him at the lens
throws his body edge to edge, earth tail behind him; an owl tumbles across the lens
charges the full length of frame, muzzle up to the lens; an owl plants a bare door frame upright ahead
bounds at the frame, dust bursting under him; an owl hangs a tie on the empty opening
hurls his body sideways through the opening, it bursts into laths; an owl clings to them, dragged to the lens
rolls out of the gap into a run; two owls unroll a bristle mat under his paws
hooks the mat on the move and drags it the whole width; both owls tumble into the lens
swats the key aside without slowing; an owl flings it on a wing, the key flies into the lens
brakes sideways and skids the full width, earth crest under his paws; owls scatter into the lens
whips the mat up behind him like a tail across frame; two owls tumble off it into the lens
an owl throws the tie, he catches it mid-run and cracks it across the lens
kicks a concrete block forward across frame, it bounces to the lens; owls scatter from its path
an owl hurls the second block, he catches it on the run and the weight swings his shoulder and muzzle into the lens, tie askew

must_appear: bare frame upright, then laths; the key into the lens; the sideways skid full width at 6.95; the mat whipped up at 7.50; the tie caught in the air at 8.05; a block bouncing at the lens at 8.60; the caught block swinging his muzzle into the lens at 9.20
negative_prompt: a prop held still and worked in place, an owl dressing the hero, a hero running at the camera on his feet, still last second, printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, a door leaf, a house, a building, night, dark scene, subtitles, speech bubble, horizontal frame, black bars, speech after 6.95, English speech, two maras, wide shot, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, hero riding anything
